mapper.select: SELECT e.ENGINEER_NO , e.MEM_NO , e.ENGINEER_NAME , e.ENGINEER_TEL , e.SPECIALTY , TIME_FORMAT(e.WORK_START_TIME, '%H:%i') AS WORK_START_TIME , TIME_FORMAT(e.WORK_END_TIME, '%H:%i') AS WORK_END_TIME , e.STATUS , m.MEM_ID FROM ENGINEER e JOIN MEMBER m ON e.MEM_NO = m.MEM_NO ORDER BY e.ENGINEER_NO

SELECT e.ENGINEER_NO , e.MEM_NO , e.ENGINEER_NAME , e.ENGINEER_TEL , e.SPECIALTY , TIME_FORMAT(e.WORK_START_TIME, '%H:%i') AS WORK_START_TIME , TIME_FORMAT(e.WORK_END_TIME, '%H:%i') AS WORK_END_TIME , e.STATUS , m.MEM_ID FROM ENGINEER e JOIN MEMBER m ON e.MEM_NO = m.MEM_NO WHERE e.ENGINEER_NO = #{engineerNo}
